name: Flowback wing valve
function: The wing valve on the opposite side of the cross that connects the well to the flowback iron and choke manifold.

tabs.overview: Closed during frac and wireline; opened for drillout returns and flowback. On some rig-ups it also carries a pressure transducer and a bleed line.
tabs.engineering: Hydraulic or manual gate valve rated with the stack.
tabs.safety: Opening the flowback wing exposes the flowback iron to wellhead pressure; the choke manifold must be lined up and the iron tested first.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

connections.note: Flowback iron to the choke manifold
